Verified: /api/config -> llm_mode=deepseek, is_mocked=false; summary generation succeeds (Russian, >200 chars, key_points) via DeepSeek->Gemini graceful fallback; test generation returns exactly 8 questions (4 MCQ / 2 TF / 2 short) in Russian with valid answer formats; POST /api/transcribe-audio works with a real ffmpeg-generated mp3 (returned {text:'Beep.'}), 405 on GET and 422 without file; full spaced-repetition loop (grade all-wrong -> 8 review_items due tomorrow -> seed-now -> /review/due -> correct answer doubles interval to next_due_days=2 -> wrong resets to 1 -> /review/stats {total,due} -> 404/422 error paths). Frontend: 4 sidebar items + numeric due badge (14 -> 11 after answering, hidden at 0), sidebar engine shows 'DeepSeek' with no ЗАГЛУШКА badge, /review card loop with feedback (Правильный + explanation + 'Следующий показ через N') and Следующая -> progression across 3 cards, empty state 'Всё в порядке. / Очередь пуста' verified, /record 4 modes incl. Аудио -> текст with real audio upload E2E (transcribing indicator -> transcript preview -> title auto-filled), lecture page print-pdf-btn present and enabled when summary exists. ONE CRITICAL BUG FOUND: short-answer grading can never be correct for Russian answers.

critical.issue: CRITICAL: _norm() in server.py:412 uses re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', s.lower()) which deletes ALL Cyrillic characters. Any short-answer question with a Russian expected answer normalizes to '' -> expected set empty -> is_correct always False, even for an exact match. Verified live: review item with answer 'хлорофилл', submitted 'хлорофилл' -> {is_correct: false, next_due_days: 1}. Consequence: max achievable test score is 75% (2 of 8 questions unpassable) and Russian short-answer review cards can never graduate out of the review queue (infinite 1-day loop). Fix: use a Unicode-aware regex, e.g. re.sub(r'[^\w]+', ' ', s.lower(), flags=re.UNICODE) (or [^0-9a-zа-яё]).

minor.issue: No cascade delete of db.review_items (tests/attempts/transcript file are cleaned, review_items are not). Deleting a lecture leaves orphaned review cards that keep appearing on /review and inflate the sidebar badge. Observed 24 orphans in the shared DB (from earlier iterations + this run); I cleaned them manually. Add: await db.review_items.delete_many({'lecture_id': lecture_id}).
Debug-only endpoint that mutates all review scheduling with no guard/flag. Consider gating behind an env flag before release.
language is hard-coded to 'en' in the Whisper call; a Russian-language lecture recording would be force-transcribed as English. Consider making language optional/auto.

rca_of_the_issue: _norm(s) = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', s.lower()) is ASCII-only. For Russian short answers every character is stripped, producing an empty expected-token set; the short-answer branch then computes overlap over an empty set and returns is_ok=False unconditionally. Reproduce: POST /api/review/{id}/answer with response == question.answer for a Cyrillic short item -> is_correct false. Mitigation: use a Unicode word regex (re.UNICODE / [^0-9a-zа-яё]) in _norm and extract the shared answer-checking logic used by grade() and review_answer().
